references.text: God gives Joshua the same encouragement 'be strong and courageous' when he takes over leadership after Moses' death
The Lord repeats the command to Joshua to be strong and courageous, and not to fear
Moses appoints Joshua as his successor by the Lord's command
Joshua, son of Nun, is to lead Israel into the land as an inheritance
Moses is told to strengthen and encourage Joshua, who will lead the people across the Jordan
The Lord Himself gives Joshua the command to be strong and courageous, for he will lead the people into the land
The Lord's promise to Abraham to give his descendants the land
The Lord confirms His oath to Isaac to give the land to his descendants
The Lord repeats His promise to Jacob to give him and his descendants the land
Encouragement to be courageous and not fear, for the Lord is our helper
